changelog: Fixed: with a config.lua from 1.0.0 (no Config.Presets) the selection menu failed to open; missing preset settings now default to on, 5 presets, 24 characters

Fixed: an error during the selection or after Play could leave the player invisible and invincible at the scene spot, which anticheats flagged as godmode; the player is now always released and spawned at the last location
If another resource loads the player while the menu is open, the menu closes and the player is moved to their character's position
BUPA Spawn Selector: if it stops or closes without spawning the player, the character spawns at the last location
